title: Guitarists around Tylertown and Jackson: Tommy Johnson, Bracey, McCoys
summary: Questions about other guitar players in Mississippi, including Tommy Johnson, Ishman Bracey, the McCoy brothers, Big Joe Williams; he played with no one but Tom.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Just Babe? Just Babe? That's just about how. That's who caught, that's how he caught your ear. Caught your eye. So he was the best around. Did you play guitar in church, babe?

No. No, it is. I've been to Sanctified Church, I've been to Church of God in Christ and all of you. Preacher plays guitar all of that. You two. Did you have any cousins that played any music? No. My nephews? Were you a young blonde? No, I was a brown. You were a brown. I was a brown. Jane Brown was my baby. I was a brown. I was a brown. I was a boy. I was a boy. I was a boy. I was a boy. Well, isn't there some sort of things to be kin to? Is it Babe or Tommy Johnson or somebody? All of Young's blood? Well, I don't know them. You know all of Young's blood? I think he's supposed to be kin to somebody. He may be an author, but I've heard you talk about it. So, did you ever hear Tommy Johnson play guitar? No. Was he any good? Yeah.
Played good. What did you hear him? Tommy Johnson.
Oh, he came to talk with him. Right.
Did you ever go up into Jackson and hear the people play around there? Yeah. Who all was up there?
Did you hear Tommy Johnson play? I feel good. I know.
Ishma and Bracey? Ishma and Bracey? No, no. He may have been gone.
The McCoy Brothers. Did you ever know them?

Who? McCoy Brothers. Charlie and Joe. They went off to Chicago, I think. So, you might not have known them. Did you ever go to Dockery's Plantation? No. No. Did you ever go to Dockery's Plantation? No. No. A lot of guys played around there. Yeah. I did that. And then Big Joe Williams, he played around Mississippi. You know him, huh? Yeah. Didn't you? Yeah. I did that. He had nine strings of dogs on him. What about banjo players? Did they have any banjo players up there? No. No. No. No. Did you ever play with anybody besides your brother Tom on the Mandalore? Did you ever play with the Mandalore? No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No. No.
